task: Composite risk index combining TC regime shifts and SLR for global mangrove ecosystems
named_methods: Tropical Cyclone Risk Index (TCRI) from Mo et al. 2023
SLR threshold analysis from Saintilan et al. 2023 (4 mm/yr, 7 mm/yr)
Composite Risk Index (CRI) combining TC and SLR components
data_sources: Global Mangrove Watch v4 (Bunting et al. 2018) - sampled 10%
IPCC AR6 SLR rates (Garner et al. 2021) - 3 SSP scenarios
MIT TC tracks (Emanuel et al. 2006) downscaled from CMIP6 MPI-ESM1-2-HR
UCSC CWON country boundaries with ecosystem service data
comparison_axes: TC vs SLR contribution to composite risk
Ecosystem services at risk (population, property, carbon)
